archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Dark Mode Enterprise Security
design_philosophy: Professional, secure, authoritative, and efficient. Emphasizes functional beauty with absolute data clarity. Eliminates playful elements in favor of high-contrast, strict alignment, and tactile density. Relies heavily on deep slate/navy bases with sharp, purposeful cyan accents to signify security and action.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' strategy combined with high-contrast utility.

spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing: Prioritize breathing room within complex views to avoid 'data overwhelm'.

surface_strategies.nav_bar: Solid background (#0f1419) with a 1px subtle border-bottom (#2c3b4e) separating content.
surface_strategies.bottom_tabs: Solid background (#1a2332) with a 1px solid top border. Unselected icons in #8b9eb0, selected in #00d9ff.
surface_strategies.cards_and_lists: Flat solid surfaces (#1a2332) with max 8px border-radius (rounded-md/rounded-lg). Avoid glassmorphism. Subtle 1px borders for structure.
surface_strategies.modals_sheets: Deepest slate (#1a2332) with heavy backdrop shadow. No blur for absolute visual clarity.

chat_bubble_sent.features: Encrypted indicator (lock icon #00d9ff), double-tick read receipts.

security_badges.e2ee_indicator: Small lock icon (Phosphor Icons or Lucide) placed next to timestamps or group names, styled with text-secondary or primary color.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00d9ff] text-[#0f1419] rounded-md font-semibold py-3 px-6 hover:bg-[#00b0cc] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#00d9ff] text-[#00d9ff] rounded-md font-semibold py-3 px-6 hover:bg-[#004b66]/20 transition-colors

inputs.chat_input: bg-[#1a2332] text-[#e1e8ed] rounded-full py-3 px-5 border border-[#2c3b4e] focus:border-[#00d9ff] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00d9ff]

icons.stroke_width: 1.5 for a sharp, precise, professional feel.

accessibility_and_motion.motion: Minimalist micro-interactions. Snap-to-place sheets, subtle scaling on press (scale-95). Fade-in lists.
accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Ensure #00d9ff text has sufficient contrast against #0f1419. If needed, use bold weights for cyan text to pass APCA standards.
accessibility_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='chat-list-item', data-testid='send-message-button').

login_background.description: Dark abstract geometric tech background for login/2FA screens. Overlay with #0f1419/80 for text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact hex codes provided for the dark enterprise theme.
Implement bottom tab navigation (Chats, Contacts, Calls, Profile) mapping to Expo React Native standard routers.
Integrate Shadcn primitives heavily customized for this dark theme. Convert them effectively to React Native views/styles if utilizing NativeWind.
All status indicators must use exact success/error/warning hex codes layered over the dark background.
Utilize the Lucide icon library for lock symbols, double-ticks, and navigation tabs. Keep stroke-width consistent at 1.5.
Enforce 'data-testid' on all pressable, text-input, and navigable components.
